# MSP430 instruction set, one statement per line, checked against
# msp430-elf-as -mcpu=430 (and -mcpu=430xv2, which shares this corpus).
# Operands that name a symbol leave the field to a relocation on both
# sides; tools/xas-diff/msp430-relocs.txt checks those relocations.

# two-operand instructions, every source mode

# two-operand instructions, every destination mode
	mov	r5, r6
	mov	#0x1234, r6
	mov	&0x202, r6
	mov	sym2, r6
	mov	r5, r0
	mov	#0x1234, r0
	mov	&0x202, r0
	mov	sym2, r0
	mov	r5, r2
	mov	#0x1234, r2
	mov	&0x202, r2
	mov	sym2, r2
	mov	r5, r3
	mov	#0x1234, r3
	mov	&0x202, r3
	mov	sym2, r3
	mov	r5, 4(r7)
	mov	#0x1234, 4(r7)
	mov	&0x202, 4(r7)
	mov	sym2, 4(r7)
	mov	r5, 0(r7)
	mov	#0x1234, 0(r7)
	mov	&0x202, 0(r7)
	mov	sym2, 0(r7)
	mov	r5, &0x300
	mov	#0x1234, &0x300
	mov	&0x202, &0x300
	mov	sym2, &0x300
	mov	r5, &sym
	mov	#0x1234, &sym
	mov	&0x202, &sym
	mov	sym2, &sym
	mov	r5, sym
	mov	#0x1234, sym
	mov	&0x202, sym
	mov	sym2, sym
	mov	r5, sym(r8)
	mov	#0x1234, sym(r8)
